{"people":[{"name":"Renee","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Owen","role":"VP of Product, champion who reached out to us","side":"customer"},{"name":"Diane","role":"CFO; froze all new vendor projects","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Engineering lead","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Former employee who built the homegrown billing system","side":"other"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"}],
 "competitors":[],
 "incumbent":"Homegrown billing system built by a former employee (status quo / doing nothing)",
 "evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"There wasn't one big thing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep says there was no trigger event; the answer opened with a hesitant 'Um. Good question.'"},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their VP of Product, Owen, had wanted to rebuild billing for a while.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Long-standing desire, not an urgent event; this is the rep's characterization."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The billing system is homegrown, built by a guy who left, and every pricing change takes them a quarter.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"Defines the incumbent and the core pain: pricing changes take a quarter."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"He reached out to us.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Inbound evaluation started by Owen."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"He wanted it done before they launched a new pricing tier, but the tier didn't have a date either.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"No compelling deadline existed."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"The CFO, I guess? Diane. She froze it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep names the decider tentatively ('I guess')."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"They missed their number in Q3 and she put a hold on all new vendor projects.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The freeze is the proximate cause of the no-decision."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"So I don't know that you'd say she decided against us. She decided against everything.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep frames the loss as not about us."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Owen told me. I never spoke to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"There was no direct contact with the economic buyer."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"No. Owen said he'd bring her in at the end.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"The CFO was never in any meeting."},
{"id":"E11","turn":12,"excerpt":"There wasn't one. It was us against doing nothing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Status quo was the real competitor."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"Owen never looked at anybody else, as far as I know.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Hedged claim; not confirmed by the customer."},
{"id":"E13","turn":14,"excerpt":"Toward the end Owen started asking for things for finance.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"The customer's questions shifted toward a finance audience."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"do you have something that shows payback?","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Introduced with 'Like,' so it may be approximate. The customer said 'payback'."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"That started maybe a month before the freeze.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"This is the rep's estimate of timing; there was a month-long window to respond."},
{"id":"E16","turn":16,"excerpt":"Reaction: the billing demo. Changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The product demo resonated with product and engineering."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's a quarter of roadmap in five minutes.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Strong customer phrasing of the value: time and roadmap."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"His engineers were into it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read of engineering enthusiasm."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't know that anything got silence.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Initial 'nothing' answer, contradicted in the same turn."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"We only ever talked to product and engineering.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Finance was never engaged."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"I said something about growing revenue","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our pitch framing was revenue growth."},
{"id":"E22","turn":16,"excerpt":"we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer explicitly rejected our revenue framing."},
{"id":"E23","turn":18,"excerpt":"The freeze email.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The moment the rep knew it would not close."},
{"id":"E24","turn":18,"excerpt":"Before that we were in procurement. Well, we'd sent paper.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Self-correction: paper had been sent, but the deal was not actually in procurement."},
{"id":"E25","turn":20,"excerpt":"I sent him the ROI deck. The general one, with the study.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"We answered the payback ask with generic material."},
{"id":"E26","turn":20,"excerpt":"I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider","language"],"note":"The generic ROI was explicitly insufficient for the CFO."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"We were going to set up a session to build one. Then Q3 closed.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"The customer-specific number was never built before the freeze."},
{"id":"E28","turn":22,"excerpt":"About a month.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's estimate of the gap between the payback ask and the freeze."},
{"id":"E29","turn":24,"excerpt":"The number. Their own. What the homegrown system costs them. Engineering time, billing errors","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Key gap: we had no customer-specific cost of the status quo."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"he mentioned once that some landlord subscriptions lapse because the card fails and nobody chases it. We never added it up.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"A quantifiable revenue leak was never quantified."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"Moving the existing subscriptions over without asking landlords for their card details again, and whether they could do it in stages.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Migration risk concern."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"we don't touch billing before renewal season.","label":"quote","speaker":"Engineering lead (customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Timing constraint around renewal season."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"We had a doc for that. He wanted to talk to someone who'd done it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer wanted a peer reference, not a doc; unclear whether one was provided."},
{"id":"E34","turn":26,"excerpt":"if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded.","label":"quote","speaker":"Diane (CFO), relayed via Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider","decided"],"note":"Double-hop quote showing the CFO's funding bar."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"Owen said finance saw it as a nice to have.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decided"],"note":"Finance perceived the project as optional."},
{"id":"E36","turn":28,"excerpt":"For Owen, yeah. For Diane, no.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Urgency was split between the champion and the economic buyer."},
{"id":"E37","turn":28,"excerpt":"I don't think anyone told her what it was costing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep concedes the cost case never reached the CFO."},
{"id":"E38","turn":30,"excerpt":"It's timing. It'll come back next year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep attributes the outcome to timing and predicts a return."},
{"id":"E39","turn":30,"excerpt":"I don't think there was anything we could have done.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"Conflicts with the gaps the rep described."}
],
 "contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E19","E21","E22"],"what":"Rep says nothing got silence, then says the revenue framing was rejected by Owen."},
{"evidence":["E39","E25","E26","E27","E29","E30","E37"],"what":"Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes a month-long window, a generic ROI deck, a customer-specific number never built, and a cost that was never told to the CFO."},
{"evidence":["E8","E38","E34","E35","E26"],"what":"Rep frames the outcome as a blanket freeze and timing, but the customer's words show it was not funded because it was not 'on fire' and had no number of its own."},
{"evidence":["E6","E9","E10","E20"],"what":"Diane is named as the decider, but the rep never spoke to her, she was in no meeting, and we only talked to product and engineering."},
{"evidence":["E24"],"what":"Rep says they were in procurement, then corrects to only having sent paper."},
{"evidence":["E11","E12"],"what":"Rep says flatly that there was no competitor, then hedges with 'as far as I know'."}
],
 "dodges":[
{"question":"What happened at the customer that started this evaluation?","turn":2,"what":"Hesitant 'Um. Good question. There wasn't one big thing.' No trigger event was identified."},
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":6,"what":"Answered 'The CFO, I guess?' Secondhand via Owen, with no direct contact."},
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":16,"what":"Said nothing got silence, then revealed the revenue framing was rejected."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":30,"what":"Deflected to timing and 'nothing we could have done' despite the gaps described."}
],
 "skipped":[],
 "language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"a tax on the roadmap","ours":"growing revenue","evidence":["E21","E22"]},
{"theirs":"a number that's ours / payback","ours":"ROI deck, the general one, with the study","evidence":["E14","E25","E26"]},
{"theirs":"a quarter of roadmap in five minutes","ours":"Changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration","evidence":["E16","E17"]},
{"theirs":"if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded / nice to have","ours":"growing revenue","evidence":["E34","E35","E21"]}
],
 "outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E23"],"what":"No decision: the CFO froze all new vendor projects after missing Q3; the deal stalled after paper was sent."},
{"evidence":["E8","E38"],"what":"Rep's view is that the loss was to the freeze and timing, not to us, and that the deal will return next year."},
{"evidence":["E26","E27","E34","E35"],"what":"The customer's words suggest it lost to the status quo for lack of a customer-specific cost or payback number for the CFO."},
{"evidence":["E11"],"what":"No competitor won; this was status quo versus us. No partial business moved."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says nothing got silence, then says the revenue framing was rejected by Owen.
Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes a month-long window, a generic ROI deck, a customer-specific number never built, and a cost that was never told to the CFO.
Rep frames the outcome as a blanket freeze and timing, but the customer's words show it was not funded because it was not 'on fire' and had no number of its own.
Diane is named as the decider, but the rep never spoke to her, she was in no meeting, and we only talked to product and engineering.
Rep says they were in procurement, then corrects to only having sent paper.
Rep says flatly that there was no competitor, then hedges with 'as far as I know'.

dodges.what: Said nothing got silence, then revealed the revenue framing was rejected.

dodges.what: Deflected to timing and 'nothing we could have done' despite the gaps described.

outcome_signals.what: No decision: the CFO froze all new vendor projects after missing Q3; the deal stalled after paper was sent.
Rep's view is that the loss was to the freeze and timing, not to us, and that the deal will return next year.
The customer's words suggest it lost to the status quo for lack of a customer-specific cost or payback number for the CFO.
No competitor won; this was status quo versus us. No partial business moved.
